target_customer: Pharma, biotech, CROs and clinical researchers running real world evidence studies
problem: Real world evidence studies on how drugs perform after approval take months. Frekil connects EHR and claims data and automates study design through final reports.
business_model: B2B software deployed in the customer's cloud, sold to life sciences teams (pricing not public)
product_category: AI real world evidence generation platform

founders.name: Nikhil Tiwari
education: IIT Bombay graduate, semester exchange at University of Geneva
founders.background_notes: Did healthcare AI research at IIT Bombay per YC page.

founders.name: Shivesh Gupta
founders.background_notes: Per YC page, declined a full time offer from an HFT firm to build Frekil.

technical_complexity.rationale: Harmonizing messy EHR and claims data and producing auditable, regulator aligned statistical analysis is hard for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Deployment in customer clouds, auditability and validation standards raise switching costs. Incumbents hold data assets that Frekil lacks.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: HealthVerity launched agentic AI RWE (eXOs with Medeloop) in September 2025 and Truveta and Atropos expanded AI RWE products. No acquisition of Frekil found.

market_need_then: Regulators and payers increasingly want real world evidence, and studies take months, per the company's pitch. AI driven RWE tools launched across the market during 2025.

branding.name_origin: Company site appears to read the name as an acronym for Fast Real-World Evidence and Knowledge Insight Loop (from a fetched summary of the site; treat as unverified)

identity.voice_and_tone: Rigor, transparency, auditability; frontier AI for post-approval evidence

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive invented name but no press on the brand itself and spelling is unusual. Searches for the name returned unrelated brands.

pivots.from: Medical imaging dataset and annotation marketplace (YC launch post titled Scale AI for Medical Scans)
pivots.to: Real world evidence generation from EHR and claims data
pivots.why: Not stated in sources; date not given

outcome_analysis: Frekil is a two person YC Spring 2025 company from IIT Bombay that moved from medical image annotation to real world evidence generation. No exit or shutdown found. It faces data rich incumbents, but the pivot targets a regulatory driven need, and customer proof and data access will decide whether it grows.
notes: Aggregators say $500K pre-seed or seed from YC (April or June 2025) and one says $1M total with 7BC Venture Capital; sources conflict and none is a company or press announcement, so no round recorded. No competitor source dated at the April 2025 batch was found; later 2025 and 2026 launches (HealthVerity, Truveta, Atropos) are named in takeover_risk_then only. The original image annotation idea would have had different competitors, not researched.
